acceptanceCriteria.text: A deterministic function compares a prior review fixture with a new-head review-input fixture.
Prior verdict is always invalidated on head rollover.
Finding states distinguish unchanged/current, resolved, obsolete and re-evaluate-required.
Evidence reuse is explicit and bounded; stale evidence is not silently retained.
Ambiguous scope changes trigger full-review fallback.
Output preserves exact old/new head provenance.
Tests cover unchanged fix-adjacent push, finding resolution, finding obsolescence, unrelated new change and full-review fallback.
This issue does not call an LLM or publish to GitHub.

issue.title: feat: carry autonomous review findings across PR head revisions
